none: PAS LON-01BFBE: Roman copper alloy nummus of an uncertain tetrachic emperor, mint uncertain, AD. 294-307, Reece period 15.
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman copper alloy nummus, probably a contemporary copy, of an uncertain tetrachic emperor, c. AD 294-307, Reece period 15. Reverse is Genius standing left holding patera and cornucopiae, legend, [GENIO POP] - VLI ROMANI. Diameter: 23.2mm, Weight: 5.74
